name: Pastoral Responsibilities
overview: Scripture emphasizes that pastoral responsibilities include vigilant oversight and care for the spiritual well-being of the church, as seen in Acts 20:28 where overseers are charged to feed the flock purchased by Christ's blood. Pastors are to address practical needs within the community, exemplified by the resolution of neglect among widows in Acts 6:1. They are also tasked with establishing godly leadership, as Paul instructed Titus to ordain elders to set things in order (Titus 1:5), and to uphold sound doctrine for teaching and correcting error (Titus 1:9). Ultimately, pastoral ministry aims at equipping believers for service and building up the body of Christ (Ephesians 4:12).
